name: rate-limiter
prompt: Implement createLimiter in src/rateLimit.js (it currently throws 'not implemented'). It is a sliding-window limiter: createLimiter({ limit, windowMs, now = Date.now }) returns { allow(key), remaining(key), reset(key) }. allow(key) returns true and records the request when fewer than `limit` allowed requests for that key happened in the last windowMs milliseconds (a request made at time t counts while now() - t < windowMs); otherwise it returns false and records nothing. remaining(key) is how many more requests would be allowed right now. reset(key) forgets the key. Keys are independent. src/middleware.js already uses it.
